opportunities.name: Movie night invite with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings
opportunities.description: For a given film, friend and day: get the director, runtime and IMDb rating from IMDb and the Tomatometer score from Rotten Tomatoes, then write an email to the friend proposing movie night with those details.
steps: Open the matching title page; note the director, runtime and IMDb rating
Open Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie_title} and open the matching movie page; note the Tomatometer %
Open the mail compose form; set To = {friend_email}
Set Body = 'Hi {friend_name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}%.'
Send the email (the user discarded every draft, so confirm before sending)

instances.values: The Grand Budapest Hotel; aisha@example.com; Sunday (IMDb 8.1, RT 92%)

opportunities.name: npm package health check logged to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package: collect the version, weekly downloads and license from npm, then the stars, open issues and last release date from its GitHub repo, and add a one-line summary to notes.
steps: On npmjs.com, search for {package_name} and open the exact-match package
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the repository link to GitHub; note the stars and open issues
Open Releases; note the latest release date
In Notes, add '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}'

instances.values: express (v5.3.0, 69.6k stars); interleaved with the movie invite workflow

opportunities.name: Recipe research with dish origin logged to notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish and serving count: pick the top Allrecipes recipe (rating, total time, key ingredients), look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, and add a summary to notes.
steps: Open the top result; note the recipe name, rating, total time and the first few ingredients
On Wikipedia, search for {dish}; read 'Place of origin' in the infobox
In Notes, add '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'

instances.values: shakshuka for 4 (Chef John's Shakshuka; origin Ottoman North Africa)
pad thai for 2 (Pad Thai; origin Thailand); included an abandoned lemon tart search
beef bourguignon for 6 (Classic Beef Bourguignon; origin France)
